effect.name: GM Flashback
effect.desc: A complete memory-sequence treatment in one effect. Five stock looks - sepia memory, bleach bypass, warm nostalgia, cold memory and faded print - set the base grade, then a real bright-pass bloom, film flicker, gate weave jitter, emulsion grain, vertical scratches, dust, a soft vignette, a directional light leak and a frame-step stutter are layered on top. Every one of those is its own control, so the same effect can be a clean sepia wash or a badly kept reel. Grade, grain, weave and bloom are all measured in layer space, so the treatment travels with the layer.
